_note: Деталь 2 — Zone 2 PEEK thermal-break sleeve (01_01 §1 + §4.1/§4.2). Frozen: bore Ø11 (= Zone-1 shaft, press-fit; canon's class H7/s6 ⊥ the tree's 5–34 µm band, which is an H7/r6 read — the band will be solved from the Lamé window, ratified 2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.3), wall 2.0 mm (robust default — NOT CTE-limited: unified Lamé §4.2 gives combined SF 5.6× / thermal-only 14.6× / press-fit-only 9×, so no mode is load-bearing), OD Ø15 = wound in tree (CODIT <25 → DBH ≥38), length 50 mm (axial thermal break, §4.1). Plain round bore: hex anti-rotation (§4.3 C, ≤0.05 mm) is bench-gated → deferred (00_07). the DIN-471 groove (Zone-1 end only since 2026-09-18, no ring fitted as a backup, 00_07 HW.26) is on the Ti part, not the PEEK sleeve; bore stays smooth (barbs press in at 150 °C, §3 steps 4-5).
name: zone2_sleeve

tolerances.fit: NO TABLE CLASS - canon 01_01 4.2 names H7/s6, but the 5-34 um diametral band on this block is the ISO 286 H7/r6 read on O11 (r6 +23/+34); H7/s6 there gives 10-39 um (s6 +28/+39). Neither is ratified: the band is to be solved from the Lame window (2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.3 - floor: the fit still holds at +40 C; ceiling: PEEK von Mises at -30 C) and only its inputs are open; 5-34 stays the tree's working input until then, although at its MIN it lies BELOW that floor

notes.process: CNC from rod; anneal 200-250 C before final micromachining (else internal stress drifts the um tolerances)
notes.post_process: None after final micromachining. The one thermal step is the 200-250 C anneal, and it belongs BEFORE that cut, not after - see process and inspection: reversing the order is the failure, not omitting a step
notes.surface_finish: smooth round bore (hex anti-rotation 4.3 C, <=0.05 mm, is bench-gated -> deferred)
notes.coating_restriction: Nothing is applied to this part - 01_02 3.6 excludes ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic layers from PEEK surfaces outright, and the Zone-2 row of that map is not blank - it carries three explicit refusals. The bore is a press-fit surface specified in micrometres (01_01 4.2), so a coating of thickness t would also eat 2t of the interference band
notes.inspection: Bore diameter and concentricity to the tolerance block on this manifest (bore axis is the primary datum). Verify the 200-250 C anneal was done BEFORE final micromachining - the order is the requirement, because internal stress released afterwards drifts exactly the micrometre-level fit this part exists to hold. OD is the WOUND diameter in the tree (01_01 1: wound 15 < 25 mm keeps CODIT tolerable, hence DBH >= 38 cm), i.e. a tree-facing dimension, not a cosmetic one: growing it raises the DBH threshold at which a tree may be instrumented
extra: Press-fit Lame-computed (HW.3.IS script 50, frozen O11/2mm, E_PEEK 4.0 GPa): contact P_c 0.49-3.32 MPa -> 0.32-2.16 at 20yr; at the MIN of the 5-34 um band (an H7/r6 read - see fit) the relaxed P_c <= sap -> this fit does not seal the Ti<->PEEK path, and by design it is not asked to (00_07 HW.34, 2026-09-18): the PEEK gap is wet and the capsule will be guarded by the bus channel's own closure at its exit (required; not yet in any drawing - its geometry waits on the pogo pin P/N, 00_07 HW.9)
OD O15 = wound in tree (CODIT <25 -> DBH >=38); wall 2.0 = robust default, NOT CTE-limited (unified Lame 4.2: combined SF 5.6x, thermal-only 14.6x)
Mechanical retention (the barbs; the DIN-471 ring as a backup was removed 2026-09-18, 00_07 HW.26) is on the Ti ends, not this PEEK bore (4.3)

The factory sheet EXISTS since 2026-09-11 (draw zone2_sleeve -> SVG + DXF, 00_07 HW.1). This part goes to a DIFFERENT shop from every other one in the family - PEEK CNC, not SLM - so its sheet is the only carrier those instructions have.
